source_cards.title: Measuring Sensory Dissonance in Multi-Track Music Recordings: A Case Study with Wind Quartets
source_cards.dataset: ChoraleBricks; ten four-part Baroque chorales with isolated wind voices
key_results: instrument choice explained 49% of intrinsic SD variation and 78% of relative SD variation in this dataset
harmonic amplitude distribution was the strongest predictor
one example bass-voice -6 dB EQ at 2-4 kHz reduced relative SD by 11 percent
limitations: absolute SD comparisons across instrument classes invalid
SD model is not identical to perceived musical dissonance
case-study EQ is not a bass-guitar prescription
deliberate distorted-rock roughness may be desirable

knowledge_cards.claim: A semantic content-conditioned spectral target is a prior, not tonal truth; it can regress intentional colour toward the corpus median.
A correct target envelope does not guarantee preferred output because the filtering stage can itself reduce preference.
Blind inverse EQ must not boost information lost to deep nulls, low SNR or nonlinear distortion.
Relative sensory dissonance is strongly dependent on timbre and context; absolute comparison across instruments is invalid.
Sensory roughness/dissonance and auditory masking are distinct; minimizing roughness may erase intentional distorted-rock aggression.
Kick and bass frequency decisions should follow section-specific musical roles rather than fixed universal slots.
When distorted bass loses drive in dense guitars, preserving or blending DI attack can be more useful than adding distortion.
A dynamic-EQ sidechain detector should represent and be auditioned for the actual collision band.

rule_candidates.name: semantic_target_as_advisory_only
rule_candidates.when: broad spectral coloration is suspected and a content-conditioned target is available
rule_candidates.change: offer a bounded candidate curve, not an automatic correction
rule_candidates.parameter_range_and_origin: no transferable gain range from source; project bounds require separate calibration
rule_candidates.undo: untreated source is preferred or style identity decreases

rule_candidates.name: block_inverse_eq_when_unobservable
rule_candidates.when: target band has deep null, poor SNR or nonlinear distortion
rule_candidates.change: block inverse boost and mark band unreliable
rule_candidates.undo: only after clean observable source is confirmed

rule_candidates.name: assign_kick_bass_roles_per_section
rule_candidates.when: kick and bass compete or the low-end foundation disappears during bass movement
rule_candidates.change: explicitly assign continuous foundation and note/attack role per section before EQ
rule_candidates.undo: role assignment contradicts arrangement or weakens musical emphasis

rule_candidates.name: preserve_bass_attack_before_more_distortion
rule_candidates.when: bass sounds large solo but loses drive and note edges in the full mix
rule_candidates.change: test clean/DI attack blend or split saturation before adding more full-band distortion
rule_candidates.parameter_range_and_origin: blend and crossover not prescribed; calibrate by experiment
rule_candidates.undo: click detaches from body, combing appears or low end thins

rule_candidates.name: dynamic_eq_only_on_detected_collision
rule_candidates.when: overlap is intermittent and correlated with the competing source
rule_candidates.change: use and audition a band-limited external detector; attenuate only during collision
rule_candidates.parameter_range_and_origin: maximum attenuation -1/-2/-3 dB project experiment grid, not source prescription; no fixed frequency or timing
rule_candidates.undo: audible holes, pumping or loss when trigger is absent

rule_candidates.name: device_labels_are_not_transferable_frequencies
rule_candidates.when: copying settings from Helios, Pultec or other broad vintage curves
rule_candidates.change: measure or audition the specific implementation instead of treating knob label as exact digital center
rule_candidates.parameter_range_and_origin: video labels and approximate centers are device-specific
rule_candidates.undo: measured/audible curve does not solve target problem

rule_candidates.name: sensory_dissonance_diagnostic_only
rule_candidates.when: comparing the same source and excerpt under controlled variants
rule_candidates.change: use relative sensory dissonance only as an auxiliary diagnostic; never minimize automatically
rule_candidates.parameter_range_and_origin: paper 2-4 kHz / -6 dB example is excluded from transferable settings
rule_candidates.undo: metric disagrees with preference or penalizes desired aggression
